text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And here's undefeated Triple Crown
hopeful Mihono Bourbon,
making her
appearance at Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon! Show us the birth of a
Triple Crown legend!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: We believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower versus Mihono Bourbon. This
Kikuka Sho will settle their
rivalry once
and for all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just keep following Bourbon... Just keep
following... Just follow, and
then...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower... I see you already have me
marked.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No matter. I will be first across the finish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Not today. I won't lose again.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Rice! You got this!

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho. 3,000 meters on turf.
Long distance is Rice's
strength, which
means she has a chance, right?

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but there's no way Bourbon doesn't
have something up her
sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainer, what'd you tell Rice?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I told her to keep following Bourbon, then
pass her.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... Wait, that's it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hard to find fault with that advice. Her
ability to stalk a leader is
second to none.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...If anything, I'm less concerned about if she can beat Bourbon, and more about how the crowd will—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen is cut off by another tidal wave
of cheers. It's almost time.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The crowning glory of the Classics is on
the line here in the Kikuka
Sho. And it all
starts now!
